decisions.text: the Board's threshold, 5% over target (threshold) taken as a deviation from the 2025 target too, so that it is drawn in the deviation's unit: +5% for every category: one value, a line across the plot (R2-13)
each value in % of its 2025 target (target): a deviation, sorted by the deviation, the 2025 target itself the zero line; the unit says so (“above target”) (G8.16)
the dividing value is 0, the 2025 target itself: above target is bad (G0.20)
a calculated value in place of the raw one: the deviation (G8.15)
type bar: categories compared by value
values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
“Sports Centre” and “Medical Sciences” come within 10 pt of each other under vertical bars, with every multi-word name wrapped: horizontal bars, names right-aligned at the left
labels as a set, 0 decimals, each with its “%” (owner, 1 Oct 2026): −10%, −5%, 0%, +5%, +10%, +15%
a horizontal scale of percentages: “%” on every label, and its title centred below, without “(%)” (owner, 1 Oct 2026): “Deviation from 2025 target”
the title wraps onto two lines
highlighted in the strong shade of their colour: Sports Centre, Medical Sciences; the others keep their colour

good and bad coloured by the dividing value, 0 (lower is good): bad Data Centre, Library, Chemistry Building, Sports Centre, Medical Sciences; good Castle Court Halls, Students' Union, Ridgeway Halls, Engineering Workshops, Arts Tower (G4.16)
Board's threshold, 5% over target (5) as a dotted line in the dark grey across the plot, labelled at its end in bold (D-21 (c), G8.13, G7.16)

static output, in colour: one file, red for bad and green for good, plain, for every reader (D-18; owner, 1 Oct 2026); black and white (audience.bw_risk) adds the textures, and a style may choose the colour-blind-safe pair (--good-bad-mode: safe-pair)
